mētālis , e, adj. meta, III. 3,
I.conical (post-class.): forma, Paul. ex Fest. s. v. tutulum, p. 335 Müll.—Hence, adv.: mētālĭ-ter , conically (post-class.): “majus corpus ejus quo umbra metaliter jacitur, quam umbra ipsa,” Mart. Cap. 8, § 859 ; id. 8, § 870.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
